purpose: All-gene molecular comparator bypassing the decoder, not the fold-native encoder; no state-law, abundance or joint prediction claim

order: 48 population variances of tanh(fold-native source states)
48 means of the same features in the positive-RNA-cell-equal source NTC pool
48 population variances in that source NTC pool
log positive regularized complete-catalog source frequency
source_features.support_use: Guide/target identities route rows and training reductions only. Pooled-control frequency and support are aggregated over the prespecified NTC catalog; state moments pool cells, not guide means.

response.scale: natural log(1+10000 times equal-positive-cell mean RNA composition), all 18129 ordered genes
response.prediction: Observed Stim8hr readout plus ridge-predicted change
response.pooling: Pool NTC compositions before nonlinear transformation, exactly matching the new molecular companion
response.constraints: Predicted transformed endpoints are unconstrained finite real values. No clipping, inverse transformation or renormalization into a fictitious composition. Score directly on the registered transformed scale.

fitting.rows: Paired-support targeting guides plus exactly one pooled-control row per fitting donor
fitting.weighting: Equal donors; within each donor, one half total weight to targeting rows and one half to its pooled-control row; targeting weight equal across represented targets and then across guides within target
fitting.standardization: Weighted fitting-only feature mean and population variance; exact constant columns receive unit scale. No response standardization or validation-donor scaling.
fitting.objective_per_gene: sum_i w_i (delta_y_ij - intercept_j - standardized_x_i B_j)^2 + lambda ||B_j||^2, sum_i w_i=1; intercept unpenalized
fitting.solver: FP64 positive-definite Cholesky with explicit residual check; no jitter, pseudoinverse or automatic fallback
fitting.gene_blocks: All genes exactly once in original order, caller-bound block and workspace limits; no dense whole-cohort RNA matrix required

selection.inner: Six distinct fitting pairs times four strengths: 24 proposed small linear fits, shared only under exact same source bindings
selection.outer: One selected strength per outer selector, refit on its three fitting donors: four proposed fits
selection.seeds: Deterministic linear solve, not a three-seed neural family
selection.risk: Equal mean across the three permitted inner donors of 0.5*(target_endpoint_mse + pooled_control_endpoint_mse)
selection.tie: Exact equal risk selects stronger regularization
selection.effect: Report effect MSE and zero-effect comparison separately; do not choose the penalty from outer errors or insert this incomplete-capability reference into the nine-channel neural selector
selection.forecast_release: All source-supported targeting forecasts and pooled control sealed before outer truth access; pair support materialized afterward under the existing common-support rule

outstanding_before_execution: Exact fitting/query rows, source summaries, composition files, feature identities and input permissions
Bound and approve the 28 small fits separately from the 28 abundance-head fits; these counts are not interchangeable
Actual linear-solver numerical qualification, aggregate operations, CPU/RAM/output allocation and publication owner
Source inventory, selected observation artifacts, forecast release and assessment integration
current_work: Implementation and fabricated arithmetic tests only. No real donor outcomes, numerical linear solves, optimizer calls, new GPU jobs or main-model training authorized by this file.
